blind.B1: No for an exercise question: RNA-seq is basal gastrocnemius, Sirt6 KO vs WT (S2.4.p1, FIG4a, S4.15.p1); no sample carries an exercise factor. The paper's exercise transcriptome is human GSE9103 (S4.16.p1).
blind.B2: KO vs WT gastrocnemius, 3 vs 3 (FIG4a 'analyzed in triplicate').
blind.B3: None: independent mice; the title suffix key only matches labels across genotypes.
blind.B4: Paper does not say for the model fit; FIG4 legend: 'Negative binomial Wald Test using DESeq2 (a)' for one two-group comparison.
blind.B5: '> 2-fold change and p < 0.05' (FIG4a legend), raw p, strict inequality; no DEG count reported.

checks.evidence: Packet A: no exercise words in any column; FIG4a/S4.15.p1 use basal 20-wk gastrocnemius, WT vs KO. Refusal at design matches B1.
Refused before contrast; groups WT 3 / KO 3 match FIG4a triplicates.
No contrast run; paper direction is KO relative to WT (S2.4.p1).
Packet A candidate key 'suffix of title' is only a WT1/KO3 label match across genotypes; expression check not_supported (p=0.51); paper has independent mice, no repeated measures.
Only one contrast (KO vs WT); no pairwise/joint question.
No batch/housing data; sex unknown but paper says male mice. Not relevant since refused.
Integer StringTie read counts, 45-63 M reads; DESeq2 route fits FIG4 legend. FPKM/TPM columns dropped.
FIG4a legend: '> 2-fold change and p < 0.05' = raw p, |log2FC|>1; HANDBACK transcribes this. Paper gives no DEG count.
No ours-vs-paper comparison claimed; HANDBACK states no DE was run.
Claim 'no exercise arm' is true and established from metadata, GEO design and paper text (no exercise words in any column; Methods describe untrained mice).

human_items: Open policy: whether a genotype-only series from an exercise paper should be refused (as done) or analyzed as a labelled non-exercise KO vs WT contrast.
summary: 该序列只有基础状态下的WT与Sirt6 KO腓肠肌(3 vs 3),没有运动因素,拒绝运行的理由属实,且检查范围足够。阈值转录正确(>2倍且原始p<0.05),不存在重复测量。无阻断或主要问题。
